_README: This ROM uses SuperGame mapper (cart type 0x0112)

comments.f7:D9B4: runs one copy script from CopyScripts at offset X, calling MemCopy per row (corrected 2026-11-08: not a one-row table, each caller starts at its own script)
comments.f7:D9E4: copy ($4E/$4F) bytes from ($4A) to ($4C). $4A-$4D are scratch here, the same cells other code dispatches through as DLI vectors
comments.f7:C1C8: once per frame, in the last handler of the display-interrupt chain: counts frames since the last DLL flip
comments.f7:C27A: one SWCHA sample per frame (corrected 2026-11-08, not 7 per frame): stored in slot FramesSinceFlip of the buffer SampleBufSelect picks, while fewer than 7 frames have passed
comments.f7:D8B3: at the DLL flip: latch the frame count for the main loop (b2:BECD makes it the step count $2642, 1-7) and restart it
comments.f7:D8E2: copy palette set Y/2 (dat_D377 pointers) to $017A-$0191 and flag it for the NMI. $4A/$4B are a copy source here, which the first vector probe logged as jump targets

headers.f7:C6D1: HUD and message text, not code (corrected 2026-11-08, see docs/DISCOVERY.md). Character codes: $50-$5F are 0-9 and A-F (the digit table just above), other letters by their own codes ($60 H, $61 I, $62 M, $63 O, $64 P, $65 R, $6A S, $6B T, $6D L, $6E N, $6F G, $70 K, $71 U, $72 V, $73 X), $6C ':', $78 blank. CopyScripts copies each string into the text-line RAM at $2560-$25C6. HI SCORE is 8 bytes and runs on into SCORE, which is also copied alone
headers.f7:C6DC: 4 bytes ':', blank, blank, ':' copied to $258E. Not JMP ($7878): the earlier $00B0-stub reading came from listing these bytes as code (corrected 2026-11-08)
headers.f7:C746: DLL tails, not code (corrected 2026-11-08): bank 2 (b2:BE1C-BE8E) copies one of these four onto the end of the DLL it is building, through MemCopy. 3-byte DLL entries; the $25D4-$263A lists they name are the ones copied from HudDisplayLists. A is chosen when $2543 and $2547 bit 7 are clear and SWCHB bit 6 is clear, or bit 6 is set with $26A1 bit 7 set
headers.f7:C758: chosen when $2543 and $2547 bit 7 are clear, SWCHB bit 6 is set and $26A1 bit 7 is clear
headers.f7:C76A: chosen when $2543 bit 7 is clear and $2547 bit 7 is set
headers.f7:C77C: 15 bytes (5 entries), chosen when $2543 bit 7 is set
headers.f7:C794: 109 bytes of display lists ($6D), not code (corrected 2026-11-08): CopyScripts row X=$6C copies $C794-$C800 to $25D4. 5-byte character-mode headers (mode byte $60: extended, indirect) naming the text lines at $25xx, each list ending $00,$00
headers.f7:D940: copy scripts for CopyScriptRun: rows of count (word), source, destination; a zero count ends a script. Callers pick a script by X: $00 TIME REMAINING BONUS or $08 BIKES PASSED BONUS (EBBD, X from sub_EB91/sub_EB9E), $10 the bonus digits (EBDF), $18 GAME OVER (EDD1), $30 the HUD labels (EDA8), $5C LAP: (EE65), $6C the HUD display lists (F51F). No call in the ROM passes $20 (EXTRA TIME!), $28 (FINAL LAP) or $64 (FINISH)
headers.f7:D383: six 24-byte palette sets, not code (corrected 2026-11-08, see docs/DISCOVERY.md; D383, D39B and D3B3 were entries). sub_D8E2 picks one through the dat_D377 pointers (Y = 0, 2 ... 10) and copies it to $017A-$0191 with $0179 as the pending flag; sub_D8FA, from the NMI at $C277, writes them to P0C1-P7C3 through the register list at dat_C834+1
